# FilterTime

> > FilterTime is an air filter subscription service delivering HVAC filters directly to homes, founded by Dale Earnhardt Jr. and Blake Koch, offering MERV-rated pleated filters made in the USA.

FilterTime provides a convenient subscription-based delivery service for residential and RV air filters across 65+ sizes. The company specializes in MERV 8, 11, and 13 pleated filters designed to improve indoor air quality and HVAC system efficiency.
